method: This is a sample edition, made by hand to test the look. Its stories were chosen and sorted by a person from the feeds of 25 outlets on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Every headline is the publisher’s own, word for word, and opens the publisher’s story.

The finished edition will be picked by counting. Headlines about the same event are grouped, and a story is big when many separate outlets report it. The cover story is the one reported by the most outlets. Nobody hand-picks it.

Every edition has the same ten sections in the same order, each with a fixed number of places: Home 4, World 4, Business 2, Science & Health 2, Tech 1, Culture 1, Sport 1, Food 1, one long read, and one story to finish on. Politics can lead, but it only fills its own section.
A section may run short but never borrows. If a section has nothing good, it is absent that day.
One link per story, to an outlet that lets you read it. The app never goes past a paywall or meter and never keeps a publisher’s story on a server.
One edition a day. It is not updated after it is published, apart from a dated correction. No opinion columns, no games, no weather.
